findings.message: Section 10.1 'Files' lists everything that lives under state_dir and says "`chupa.lock` | The single-writer lock." After this diff, Journal.append creates `<state_dir>/journal.lock` and takes an exclusive flock on it for every append. That file is missing from the table, and chupa.lock no longer guards journal writes. The diff even updates test_storm_producer to expect journal.lock in the state-dir listing, yet the documented listing still describes the old layout.
findings.paved_road: Add a `journal.lock` row to the section 10.1 table: a short-held exclusive flock taken by every journal append, covering torn-tail repair, segment roll and the write. Reword the `chupa.lock` row so it says the lock guards checkout and git writes to main, not journal appends.
